About the show

Our free touch tours provide an opportunity to become more familiar with the set, scenery, props and costumes. This aims to help audience members living with sight loss to immerse themselves in the world presented on stage, with audio describers, stage management and wardrobe staff present to...

Concessions at Theatre Royal

An ATG house. Concessions are set per production rather than by the venue, so the booking page is the only place they appear; two memberships run across every ATG theatre.

Access Membership Scheme

Free, and open to all Deaf and disabled customers and people with long-term health conditions. Unlocks accessible seats online, any Access concessions on a show, and personal assistant tickets.

Register once at atgtickets.com/access.

ATG+

A paid membership: no booking fees on most ATG shows, priority booking and member discounts across 35+ venues.
